name: Hanseatic City of Lübeck
description: Lübeck, in northern Germany near the Baltic coast, was the "Queen City" of the medieval Hanseatic League. Its old town sits on a compact island ringed by water, with red-brick Gothic churches whose spires give it the nickname "City of Seven Towers." The twin-towered Holstentor gate, patrician houses and old salt storehouses still line its streets.
